evidence.snippet: if (!params.state) { Logger.warn('OAuth callback missing state parameter'); }
evidence.why: State parameter is only logged as a warning when absent, never validated against a stored value, and processing continues regardless.
Code exchange proceeds without any state comparison and without a PKCE code_verifier.

evidence.snippet: grant_type: 'authorization_code', code: authCode, redirect_uri: this.REDIRECT_URI, client_id: this.CLIENT_ID, client_secret: this.CLIENT_SECRET,
evidence.why: Token exchange has no code_verifier/PKCE parameter, and relies on a client_secret embedded in the mobile app, with no state validation tying this exchange to the originating request.

other_classes_observed: hardcoded client_secret embedded in mobile client (CWE-798)
